VBO:0200372.summary: Cheerful, affectionate and eager to share in human activity, the Cocker family comprises two distinct breeds: American and English Cocker Spaniels. Both retain a sporting heritage rooted in working through dense cover to find woodcock. American Cockers often delight in play and retrieving games; English Cockers commonly show a stronger field instinct alongside close attachment to their people.
VBO:0200372.shortDescription: American and English Cockers form a cheerful, affectionate sporting family with woodcock-hunting roots and a love of company.
